The '''Alliance disruptor''' was a type of energy-based [[Disruptor pistol/Legends|disruptor pistol]] commonly used by [[Medic/Legends|medics]]. It was was standard issued to members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptors]] were a type of [[Limb/Legends|handheld]], energy-based [[Disruptor pistol/Legends|disruptor pistol]]. The weapon was composed of various materials, including units of [[plumbum]] [[Iron/Legends|iron]], non-ferrous metal, and other chemicals. It also comprised of a number of different components, including a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] component and a ranged weapon core. Optional components included a [[Scope/Legends|scope]] and [[Stock/Legends|stock]].<ref name="AED" />

==History==
The weapon saw use during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and Alliance to Restore the Republic, following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="AED" /> Commonly used by [[Medic/Legends|combat medics]], the weapon was standard issued to members of the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="COTF">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|cardname=Alliance Disruptor}}</ref> Schematics of the weapon were also available to independent [[weaponsmith]]s and [[Merchant/Legends|munitions traders]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:AllianceDisruptor.png|170px|thumb|Another view of the Alliance disruptor pistol]]
The [[W:c:swg:Alliance Disruptor|Alliance disruptor]] was included as a [[W:c:swg:Pistol|pistol]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies'']] publish archives indicate that the [[W:c:swg:Weapon|weapon]] was added to the game either during the [[W:c:swg:Combat Upgrade|Combat Upgrade Version 0.122039]] on [[May 5]], [[2005]] or [[W:c:swg:Publish 17 Notes for 26 May 2005|Publish 17.0]] on [[May 26]], 2005.<ref name="NGE">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> After being included to the game, the weapon could be [[W:c:swg:Crafting|crafted]] by [[W:c:swg:Weaponsmith (pre NGE)|weaponsmiths]] for primary use by players of the [[W:c:swg:Combat Medic|combat medic]] [[W:c:swg:Professions (pre-NGE)|profession]].<ref name="AED" />

Following the release of [[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15 2005|Publish 25's]] [[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]] on [[November 15]], [[2005]], combat medics and weaponsmiths were removed,<ref name="NGE" /> however the weapon could still be constructed by players of the newly created [[W:c:swg:Trader (Munitions)|munitions trader]] [[W:c:swg:Profession|profession]].<ref name="AED" /> According to the [[Tech Specs: Pistols]] article published on [[March 2]], [[2007]], the weapon was dedicated to players of the newly revamped [[W:c:swg:Medic|medic]] profession following the release of the New Game Enhancements.<ref name="Tech">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66928&resource=features|text=Tech Specs: Pistols}}</ref> However, this prerequisite was eventually removed. The weapon could be constructed using a number of different [[W:c:swg:Ranged weapon component|components]] and [[W:c:swg:Resource|resources]], including [[W:c:swg:Plumbum Iron|plumbum iron]], [[W:c:swg:Non-ferrous metal|non-ferrous metal]], and [[W:c:swg:Chemical|chemicals]].<ref name="AED" /> A couple ''Star Wars Galaxies'' reference guides feature the [[W:c:swg:Rebel Alliance|Alliance]] disruptor, including [[Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience'': Prima Official Game Guide]]<ref name="Total">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> and ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide]]'' (2005).<ref name="Complete">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> In [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|''Champions of the Force'']], the first set of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' released on [[August 19]], [[2008]], the Alliance disruptor was introduced as a game [[W:c:swg:Card list|card]]. The artwork for the Alliance disruptor illustration was completed by [[Erich Schreiner]].<ref name="COTF" /> Capitalization of the weapon's name was somewhat inconsistent between sources. ''The Total Experience: Prima Official Game Guide'' and ''The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide'' fully capitalize the weapon as an Alliance Disruptor,<ref name="Total" /><ref name="Complete" /> as did its card for [[W:c:swg:Champions of the Force|''Champions of the Force'']].<ref name="COTF" /> ''Star Wars Galaxies'' likewise capitalized the name in the weapon's title, but examining the pistol revealed a description which read, "An Alliance disruptor."<ref name="AED" />
